Switch to OLD wallet → Base → Send USDC (~$181) to NEW SAFE address → triple-check → Send.
Same wallet → Send VIRTUAL (~$12). Leave a little ETH for gas; then send rest of ETH if you want.

Trust Wallet → Settings → Wallets → delete the imported burned wallet. Never re-import that phrase.
